prompt.name: Héritage du projet — terrain
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. CARTER, the ORIGINAL CQC project character shown in the reference, costume “Héritage du projet — terrain”. This is the project-authored older grey-haired male Carter, not a claimed canonical Metal Gear character and not another named hero. Preserve his distinctive older lined face, short swept silver hair, medium sturdy build and serious right-looking profile from the reference. Create a coherent new field overlayer: a short split olive-brown waxed weather cape on the shoulders, high grey-tan scarf collar, compact fitted charcoal utility vest over faded sand camouflage, square repair patches, one closed map-case pouch and a low compact medical/tool satchel attached at belt. Durable brown gloves and boots; no enormous camping backpack, no cape dragging on ground. Practical individual clothing construction, dust and minor wear, no weapon in hands, no written labels. One grounded full-body neutral right-facing standing pose, same human proportions as base.

visualReview.description: Project-original older male Carter identity, new compact field overlayer; no claim of canonical franchise identity.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: project-original older grey-haired Carter, preserved face/build, new compact waxed shoulder weather cape, scarf, utility vest, closed map case and medical satchel. Explicitly not a canonical Metal Gear identity.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
